summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 a stockholder letter disclosing a reduction in its monthly distribution rate to $0.026 per share for the distribution payable to holders of record as of September 30, 2026, to align the payout with portfolio earnings capacity and expected cash flows. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is a routine dividend-rate reset rather than a special situation; watch distribution coverage, portfolio cash flow and any further NAV or repurchase-plan disclosures.
